analysis:
Examined two additive changes.

1) ProcessMemoryLedger.swift (head lines 198-224): new capacityShortfall(growthBytes:additionalSystemReserveBytes:) is a read-only query. It takes the ledger lock, calls prepareUsageReader() before the lock (consistent with the documented lock order), then readUsage() under the lock like recheckCharge and snapshot. It does not mutate charge, coverage, or policy, and grants no admission. Arithmetic uses checked adds that saturate to .max, and subtract() floors at 0. The formula max(capDemand-cap, systemDemand-systemAvailable) mirrors headroom() (min of cap/system remainders minus reserve), so it is consistent with replaceCharge/recheckCharge admission. One subtlety: when needed==0 it returns 0 even if usage is already inside the reserve, which is benign. Callers are not in the supplied batch. If the shortfall drives reclaim (e.g. cache eviction) in an unchanged caller, an over-large .max value could cause aggressive eviction. That is an availability/cache-purge concern, not a confidentiality one, and does not touch T-041 at-rest mitigations.

2) WholeMacServiceBudget.swift (head lines ~227-247): isIdle(for:) and performIfIdle(for:_:) are new. They use the same lock and idle predicate as quiescenceSatisfiedLocked (no charges, no unbounded activities, idleSince+duration elapsed). performIfIdle runs the body under the budget lock, which blocks acquire and beginUnboundedActivity, so there is no TOCTOU between check and work. The risk is deadlock or long lock hold if a caller's body reenters the budget or does slow work. The doc says it must not. Callers are not visible in this batch; I could not verify that they obey this or that the work done is bounded. This is an availability integration question only. It touches no keys, attestation, authorization, or plaintext.

No security regression is identified against the retained threat model (T-041, T-010, T-029). Remaining question for the next pass: confirm callers of capacityShortfall and performIfIdle (probably idle calibration or cache reclaim) do no I/O, GPU work, or reentrancy under the lock.
